facts.text: Hillsdale College declines all federal taxpayer student aid and replaces federal funds entirely with private institutional aid.

sources.title: The President's Club Mission & History - Hillsdale College
sources.quote: In response, Hillsdale's trustees made a bold decision to notify students that they no longer could accept federal taxpayer aid to attend Hillsdale. Simultaneously, they committed to replacing the lost federal taxpayer dollars with private ones
